Run CellChat across normalization methods

run_ccc.Rd

Runs CellChat cell-cell communication analysis across multiple normalized versions of the same SpatialExperiment object.

Usage

run_ccc(
  spelist,
  celltype_col,
  database,
  spatial_factors,
  interaction_range,
  contact_range,
  assay_name = "logcounts",
  nboot = 100,
  min_cells = 10,
  trim = 0.1,
  scale_distance = 0.1,
  variable_both = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

spelist

Named list of SpatialExperiment objects. Names should correspond to normalization methods.

celltype_col

Character. Column in colData(spe) containing cell-type labels.

database

CellChat database object, e.g. CellChatDB.mouse.

spatial_factors

Data frame containing CellChat spatial factors, typically ratio and tol.

interaction_range

Numeric. Maximum spatial interaction distance.

contact_range

Numeric. Contact-dependent interaction distance.

assay_name

Character. Assay containing normalized expression. Default is "logcounts".

nboot

Integer. Number of bootstrap iterations.

min_cells

Integer. Minimum number of spots/cells per group.

trim

Numeric. Trimming proportion for truncated mean.

scale_distance

Numeric. Distance scaling used by CellChat.

variable_both

Logical. Passed to identifyOverExpressedInteractions().

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages.

Value

Named list containing CellChat results for each method.
